Subject: Helios migration runforward & safety questionnaire

Priya / Carlos,

Thanks again for the RFI — attached is our initial answers workbook (Helios_RFI_Answers_v1.xlsx) plus a draft canary runbook PDF that lays out tooling, monitoring signals, and rollback triggers. High level callouts: 

- We propose a three-phase migration: staging validation (2 weeks), canary (1 week), ramp-to-production (2–3 weeks). Detailed GANTT attached (Migration_Schedule_GANTT.csv).
- Canary scope: 5% traffic on representative cohorts (auth flows + high-confidence inference), with automatic prefix cache priming and a 10-minute baseline observation window before ramp.
- Rollback triggers: 3x error-rate increase OR 20% latency P95 regression OR quality regression detected by prompt-eval set. Runbook details are in Helios_Canary_Runbook_v2.pdf.

Could you review the canary definitions and tell us which customer cohorts you want in scope (e.g., retail vs. corporate), and whether Helios requires a pilot with read-only traffic first?

I'm looping Aditya on commercial milestones and Laura on verification/ops handoff. Happy to hop on a 30-minute call to walk through the plan and iterate.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference
attachments: [Helios_RFI_Answers_v1.xlsx, Helios_Canary_Runbook_v2.pdf, Migration_Schedule_GANTT.csv]

Jonas,

Thanks for the quick turn. A few clarifications from the Helios side: 

1) Cohorts: start with retail web (session-based flows) and a small internal corporate cohort for feature parity tests. We'd like to avoid auth-path production traffic on first canary; read-only mirror for auth OK.
2) Metrics: for quality regression we'd like the custom prompt-eval set (we'll share) to be scored every 30 minutes during canary. If there's any drop > 2% in top-1 accuracy, we want automatic pause and escalation.
3) Compliance: SOC2 artifacts and network topology diagrams are requested before canary start. Can you confirm where those live?

We can do a sync next Tue 10–10:30am ET. Carlos will own ops coordination and I'll own procurement sign-offs.

- Priya Shah
Head of Platform Integrations
Helios Financial

Priya — thanks, helpful guidance. Short answers below and an updated plan attached (Helios_RFI_Answers_v1.xlsx includes a new "Canary Controls" tab).

- Cohorts: we'll mirror auth traffic for verification but not route live auth requests until Helios signs off. Retail web + internal corporate cohort will be the primary canary.
- Eval cadence: we can run the shared prompt-eval set every 15 minutes and add the 30-minute aggregation threshold you requested; we'll implement an automated pause if top-1 accuracy drops >2% over a rolling 30-minute window.
- SOC2 & topology: SOC2 Type II summary, network diagram, and KMS integration notes are in Drive (link below). I've attached the updated runbook and migrated schedule.

Proposed short timeline (UTC converted for your team):
- Week 0 (validation): verify endpoints, token handling, and shared eval set ingestion (2 business days)
- Week 1 (staging): full functional tests against mirrored traffic (5 business days)
- Week 2 (canary): 5% traffic for 7 calendar days with 48-hour observation plateau before 50% ramp
- Week 3–4 (ramp): step-up to 25% then 100% over 7–10 business days, with canary gates at each step

Owners:
- Redwood: Jonas (technical runbook), Laura (ops integration), Aditya (commercial milestones)
- Helios: Priya (procurement), Carlos (ops/traffic owners)

If that reads ok, I'll send a brief mutual action plan and a Docusign wrapper for the pilot commitment (small credit + 30-day rollback guarantee).

Best,
Jonas
